scope.summary: Deterministic fixed-window known-target short-DNA assignment from FASTQ.
requires: a finite table of expected short DNA target sequences
a known or reviewed read-window start and length

platforms: Linux x86_64 or aarch64 with glibc or musl
macOS 11 or newer on Apple Silicon or Intel
limitations: The published Python wheels do not currently include Windows.
Check dotmatch --version when an exact release matters; Bioconda can lag PyPI.

outcomes.unique: Exactly one target is compatible; the read may contribute to that target count.
outcomes.ambiguous: More than one target is compatible; the read is not forced into a target count.
outcomes.none: No target is compatible within the configured distance.
outcomes.invalid: The requested fixed window cannot be extracted from the read.

intents.task: Count a CRISPR guide library and write a MAGeCK-compatible matrix
queries: count sgRNAs from a CRISPR screen
intents.command: dotmatch crispr-count --library guides.tsv --samples samples.tsv --guide-start 23 --guide-length 20 --k 1 --out counts.mageck.tsv --summary summary.json --sample-qc sample_qc.tsv
inputs: sample sheet TSV or CSV pointing to FASTQ or FASTQ.gz files
zero-based guide start and guide length
limitations: DotMatch counts known guide windows; it does not perform downstream screen statistics.
Audit the guide library before using mismatch correction.

intents.task: Split FASTQ reads by fixed-position inline sample barcodes
queries: split FASTQ by known sample barcodes
intents.command: dotmatch demux --barcodes barcodes.tsv --reads pooled.fastq.gz --barcode-start 0 --barcode-length 8 --k 1 --metric hamming --out-dir demuxed --summary demux.summary.json
inputs: zero-based barcode start and barcode length
outputs: one split FASTQ per uniquely assigned barcode
optional ambiguous, unmatched, and assignment files
limitations: This path starts from FASTQ and does not perform basecalling.
High ambiguity or unmatched rates require window, orientation, and target-sheet review.

intents.task: Assign fixed-window feature-barcode reads to a known feature list
queries: known feature tag matching from FASTQ
intents.command: dotmatch count --targets features.tsv --reads feature_R2.fastq.gz --sample-label sample --target-start 0 --target-length 15 --k 1 --metric hamming --out feature_counts.tsv --assignments feature_assignments.tsv --summary feature_summary.json
limitations: The checked public lane covers per-read fixed-window feature assignment.
DotMatch does not perform cell-barcode, UMI, CITE-seq, or Cell Ranger quantification.

intents.task: Assign fixed-window Perturb-seq or CRISPR guide-capture reads
queries: match guide capture reads to known guides
intents.command: dotmatch count --targets guides.tsv --reads guide_capture_R2.fastq.gz --sample-label sample --target-start 63 --target-length 19 --k 0 --metric hamming --out guide_counts.tsv --assignments guide_assignments.tsv --summary guide_summary.json
limitations: The checked public guide-capture evidence is a single-guide extraction lane, not useful multi-guide assignment evidence.
DotMatch does not call guides per cell or process expression, cell barcodes, UMIs, or perturbation effects.

intents.task: Design or check a barcode panel before sequencing
inputs: requested barcode count and length or an existing barcode table
a panel preset or explicit design constraints
outputs: panel certificate and machine-readable safety records
limitations: This designs short barcode sets, not hybrid-capture probes, PCR primers, or full sequencing assays.
Validate synthesis and instrument-specific constraints outside DotMatch.

intents.task: Count any known short-DNA target list from a fixed FASTQ window
queries: match short sequencing reads to a whitelist
count primers adapters or panel targets from FASTQ
intents.command: dotmatch count --targets targets.tsv --reads sample.fastq.gz --sample-label sample --target-start 0 --target-length 20 --k 0 --metric hamming --out counts.tsv --sample-qc sample_qc.tsv --summary summary.json
inputs: zero-based target start and target length
limitations: Targets must be finite and known before assignment.
This is fixed-window short-DNA assignment, not local or whole-read genome alignment.

intents.task: Diagnose high unmatched, ambiguous, invalid, or low-quality barcode assignments
intents.command: dotmatch barcode autopsy --barcodes barcodes.tsv --reads pooled.fastq.gz --scan-starts 0:12 --k-values 0,1 --out-dir autopsy
inputs: a plausible range of barcode starts
outputs: offset scans, collision records, and frequent unmatched windows
limitations: The report proposes settings for review; it cannot infer unavailable sample-sheet or wet-lab context.
Do not use mismatch correction when the target audit reports unsafe collisions.

error_recovery.reason: Frequent unmatched windows expose offset, orientation, target-sheet, trimming, and contamination problems.

error_recovery.symptom: High ambiguous rate or unsafe mismatch correction
error_recovery.reason: The target audit records duplicates and near neighbours that can make correction non-unique.
Confirm that target-start plus target-length fits the post-trimming read length.
The installed manifest maps supported tasks to commands, inputs, outputs, evidence, and limitations.
